tournament_winner.question: Will Novak Djokovic win the 2024 French Open Men's Singles?
tournament_winner.description:
The market will resolve to “Yes” if Novak Djokovic wins the 2024 French Open Men's Singles tournament. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

If for any reason the tournament is cancelled or rescheduled to an end date after July 1, 2024, this market will resolve to "No".

If it can be definitively determined at any point that this player will not be the winner of the 2024 French Open Men's Singles based on the rules of the tournament, this market may immediately resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from The French Open/Roland Garros, including footage of the tournament, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

olympic_gold.question: Will Djokovic win a gold medal in Paris?
olympic_gold.event_title: Will Djokovic win a gold medal in Paris?
olympic_gold.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Novak Djokovic wins a gold medal in the Olympic Games Paris 2024. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This market may resolve to "No" if it becomes impossible for Djokovic to win a gold medal at the 2024 Paris Summer Olympics.

This market will resolve based on the first medal results for each event Djokovic is competing in. Once medals are awarded in all events this player is competing in, this market may resolve immediately.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the IOC, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

moneyline.question: US Open: Shelton vs. Tiafoe
moneyline.description:
Ben Shelton and Francis Tiafoe are scheduled to play each other in a third round matchup in the US Open Men’s Singles Tournament on August 30, 2024 at 1:15 PM ET. 

This market will resolve to “Shelton” if Ben Shelton wins his match against Francis Tiafoe in the third round of the US Open Men’s Singles tournament. 

This market will resolve to “Tiafoe” if Francis Tiafoe wins his match against Ben Shelton in the third round of the US Open Men’s Singles tournament. 

If the match ends in a tie, is canceled, or delayed beyond September 6, 2024, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the US Open (ex:https://www.usopen.org/index.html) including live footage, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

reach_round.question: Will Jannik Sinner reach the quarterfinals of the Australian Open?
reach_round.event_title: Who will reach the quarterfinals of Australian Open?
reach_round.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Jannik Sinner reaches the quarterfinals of the 2025 Australian Open Men’s Singles tournament. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this player to reach the quarterfinals of the Australian Open Men’s Singles Tournament (e.g., they are eliminated in a prior round), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the Australian Open (https://www.ausopen.com), however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

win_a_major_in_year.question: Will Alexander Zverev win a Grand Slam tournament in 2025?
win_a_major_in_year.event_title: Who will win a Grand Slam tournament in 2025?
win_a_major_in_year.description:
This market is predicting who will win a tennis Grand Slam tournament in 2025. 

This market will resolve to "Yes" if listed player wins a Grand Slam Tennis Tournament in 2025. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No"

The tournaments included for the rest of the year in "Grand Slam" are the 2025 US Open, French Open, and the Wimbledon.

The primary resolution source will be official information from ATP (https://www.atptour.com/en), however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

tennis_exact_score.question: Will Jannik Sinner win 3:0 against Ben Shelton?
tennis_exact_score.description:
This is a market to predict the exact set score in the Wimbledon men’s singles quarterfinal match between Jannik Sinner and Ben Shelton, scheduled for July 9, 2025.

If the listed exact set score occurs, this market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

If the match ends in a tie, is canceled, or delayed past July 10, 2025, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source will be official information from Wimbledon (https://www.wimbledon.com/index.html), however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

match_winner_and_game_margin.question: Sinner vs. Shelton: Will Sinner win by 5+ games?
match_winner_and_game_margin.event_title: Sinner vs. Shelton: Will Sinner win by 5+ games?
match_winner_and_game_margin.description:
This is a market to predict whether Jannik Sinner will defeat Ben Shelton by more than 4.5 total games in their Wimbledon men’s singles quarterfinal match, scheduled for July 9, 2025, at 9:30 AM ET. 

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Jannik Sinner wins the match and finishes with a game margin of 5 or more over Ben Shelton. Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

If the match ends in a tie, is canceled, or not completed by July 12, 2025, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be official information from Wimbledon (https://www.wimbledon.com/index.html), however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

tennis_match_totals.question: Wimbledon: Alcaraz vs. Sinner – Over 40.5 Games?
tennis_match_totals.event_title: Wimbledon: Alcaraz vs. Sinner – Over 40.5 Games?
tennis_match_totals.description:
This is a market to predict whether the Wimbledon Men's Singles Final match scheduled for July 13, 2025, between Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner will have more than 40.5 total games played.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if 41 or more total games are played during the match. Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

If the match is stopped after it begins (e.g., due to a mid-match withdrawal), this market will resolve based on the official score at the time of stoppage.

Tiebreaks will count as one game toward the total games played.

If the match ends in a tie, is canceled, or not completed by July 17, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be official information from Wimbledon (https://www.wimbledon.com/index.html); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

finalist_pair.question: US Open Final: Sinner vs. Alcaraz?
finalist_pair.event_title: US Open Final: Sinner vs. Alcaraz?
finalist_pair.description:
This is a polymarket to predict if Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz will both qualify for the 2025 US Open Men’s Singles Final.

If both Sinner and Alcaraz qualify for the 2025 US Open Men’s Singles Final, this market will resolve to “Yes.” Otherwise, it will resolve to “No.”

If both players qualify for the final, but either withdraws prior to the final match, this market will still resolve to “Yes.”

If the 2025 US Open Men’s Singles tournament is canceled or postponed past October 20, 2025, before the final match participants have been set, this market will resolve to “No.”

The primary resolution source will be official information from the US Open (usopen.org). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

tennis_first_set_winner.question: Set 1 Winner: Fritz vs Minaur

tennis_first_set_winner.description:

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official ATP match statistics.

tennis_set_handicap.question: Set Handicap: Sinner (-1.5) vs Zverev (+1.5)

Resolution will be based on official ATP results.

more_grand_slams.question: Will Alcaraz or Sinner win more Grand Slams in 2026?
more_grand_slams.event_title: Will Alcaraz or Sinner win more Grand Slams in 2026?
more_grand_slams.description:
This is a market to predict whether Carlos Alcaraz or Jannik Sinner wins more Grand Slam championships in 2026.

If Carlos Alcaraz wins more Grand Slams in 2026 than Jannik Sinner, this market will resolve to “Alcaraz”.

If Jannik Sinner wins more Grand Slams in 2026 than Carlos Alcaraz, this market will resolve to “Sinner”.

If Alcaraz and Sinner win the same amount of Grand Slams in 2026, this market will resolve 50-50.

Only victories in Men’s Singles Grand Slam tournaments will be considered for this market’s resolution. The relevant 2026 Grand Slams are the Men’s Singles tournaments in the 2026 Australian Open, French Open, U.S. Open, and Wimbledon.

If it becomes impossible for either Alcaraz or Sinner to win as many Grand Slams in 2026 as the other (e.g. Alcaraz wins the first three grand slams), this market will resolve immediately. Otherwise, this market will resolve when the results of the final 2026 Grand Slam are official.

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the organizers of the Grand Slam tournaments; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

calendar_grand_slam.question: Will Jannik Sinner win a calendar Grand Slam in 2026?
calendar_grand_slam.event_title: Who will win a Calendar Grand Slam in 2026?
calendar_grand_slam.description:
This is a market to predict who will win a men's tennis Calendar Grand Slam in 2026.

This market resolves to the single male player who wins the Men’s Singles titles at all four Grand Slam tournaments in 2026. The relevant 2026 Grand Slams are the Men’s Singles tournaments in the 2026 Australian Open, French Open, U.S. Open, and Wimbledon.

For the purpose of this market, a tournament victory is valid regardless of whether the final was won via a walkover, a mid-match retirement, or a standard completed match.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed player to achieve a Calendar Grand Slam in 2026 (e.g. Alcaraz does not win the 2026 Australian Open) this market will resolve immediately to "No". 

If at any point it becomes impossible for anyone to achieve a Calendar Grand Slam in 2026 this market will resolve immediately to "None".

Otherwise, this market will resolve when the results of the final 2026 Grand Slam are official.

If any of the 2026 Grand Slam Men’s Singles Tournaments are cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “None”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the organizers of the Grand Slam tournaments; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

participation.question: Will Roger Federer play at Wimbledon?
participation.event_title: Will Roger Federer play at Wimbledon?
participation.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Roger Federer takes the court as a player in at least one official match during the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Any on-court appearance as a player during qualifying and main Wimbledon tournament matches will qualify. No practice rounds, exhibitions, or other play of any kind will be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the ATP; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

tennis_completed_match.question: Internazionali BNL d'Italia: Completed Match: Naomi Osaka vs Diana Shnaider
tennis_completed_match.event_title: Internazionali BNL d'Italia: Naomi Osaka vs Diana Shnaider
tennis_completed_match.description: This market refers to the tennis match between Naomi Osaka and Diana Shnaider in the Internazionali BNL d'Italia, originally scheduled for May 10, 2026 at 5:00AM ET. This market will resolve to "Yes" if all games and sets required to determine a match winner under governing body or event organizer rules are played to completion through normal play. Otherwise, if the match is not completed for any reason, it will resolve to "No." If a forfeit of any kind occurs, including but not limited to a walkover or retirement, this market will resolve "No." If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to "No." The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

tennis_set_games_totals.question: Blanch vs. O'Connell: Set 2 Games O/U 8.5

Any tiebreak in set 2 counts as one (1) game toward the total.
If set 2 is not completed for any reason (including the match ending before set 2 is reached), this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins, or delayed beyond 7 days without commencement, this market will also resolve 50-50.

If the match begins but set 2 is not completed with a winner determined (including the match ending before set 2 is reached), this market will resolve 50-50.
If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Challenger match statistics.

any_match_win.question: Wimbledon 2026: Will Serena and Venus Williams Win a Doubles Match?
any_match_win.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Will Serena and Venus Williams Win a Doubles Match?
any_match_win.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Serena Williams and Venus Williams win a doubles match in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If Serena Williams or Venus Williams withdraws, the match is ruled a walkover, or the match is started but not completed (e.g., abandoned without a result), this market will resolve to 50-50. A result by retirement counts as a completed match and will resolve "Yes" or "No" according to which pair is credited the win under WTA rules.

If the match is cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the WTA; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

qualifier_reach_round.question: Wimbledon 2026: Will a Qualifier Reach the Round of 16?
qualifier_reach_round.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Will a Qualifier Reach the Round of 16?
qualifier_reach_round.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a player listed as a qualifier or lucky loser reaches the Round of 16 in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only players who entered the main draw through the qualifying tournament or are nominated as a lucky loser will be considered. Players who received direct entry into the main men’s or women’s singles tournaments of Wimbledon will not be considered.

If no qualifiers or lucky losers are admitted to the main draw at Wimbledon, this market will resolve to 50-50.


If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled, or postponed after July 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

wildcard_reach_round.question: Wimbledon 2026: Wildcard to Reach the Quarterfinals?
wildcard_reach_round.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Wildcard to Reach the Quarterfinals?
wildcard_reach_round.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a player listed as a wildcard reaches the Quarterfinals in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only players who are listed as wildcards will be considered. Players who received direct entry or advance through the qualifying tournament into the main men’s or women’s single tournaments of Wimbledon will not be considered.

If no wildcards are admitted to the main tournament at Wimbledon, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled, or postponed after July 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

defeat_top_seed.question: Wimbledon 2026: Joao Fonseca to Defeat Top-5 Seed?
defeat_top_seed.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Joao Fonseca to Defeat Top-5 Seed?
defeat_top_seed.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Joao Fonseca defeats a player seeded number 5 or higher during any main tournament match in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If Joao Fonseca withdraws from the tournament, an applicable match is ruled a walkover this market will resolve to “No”. If an applicable match is started but not completed (e.g., abandoned without a result), this market will resolve to 50-50. A result by retirement counts as a completed match and will resolve "Yes" or "No" according to which player is credited the win under AELTC rules.

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC and Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

racket_break.question: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Break a Racket?
racket_break.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Break a Racket?
racket_break.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player participating in an official match at the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon visibly breaks a racket during or immediately following that match by July 12, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

"Breaks a racket" means a player's actions visibly damage, crack, snap, shatter, or otherwise render an item unusable or clearly broken. Mere striking, slamming, or knocking over equipment without visible breakage will not qualify.

Only actions taken by a player during live match play, or immediately after the conclusion of that player's official match while on the court or on the official broadcast, will count. Damage occurring before a match, outside the official match area, during practice, backstage, or away from the broadcast match environment will not qualify.

If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon is canceled, postponed indefinitely, or if no official match of the tournament is completed by June 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No."

The resolution source will be the official Wimbledon broadcast; however, photographic and video evidence from a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

top_seed_first_round_exit.question: Wimbledon 2026: Top-10 Seed to Lose in First Round? (Men’s Singles)
top_seed_first_round_exit.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Top-10 Seed to Lose in First Round? (Men’s Singles)
top_seed_first_round_exit.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if a player seeded number 10 or higher is defeated during the first round of the Men’s Singles main tournament in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If an applicable match is started but not completed (e.g., abandoned without a result), or not played, this market will resolve to 50-50. A result by retirement or walkover counts as a completed match and will resolve "Yes" or "No" according to which player is credited the win under AELTC rules.

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC and Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

dress_code_violation.question: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Violate Dress Code?
dress_code_violation.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Violate Dress Code?
dress_code_violation.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if any player receives a penalty for violating the dress code set out by Wimbledon during the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The official dress code for the tournament will be based upon the guidelines published by Wimbledon (​​https://www.wimbledon.com/en_GB/the_championships/clothing_and_equipment).

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or it cannot be determined if any player has been penalized for a dress code violation during this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

longest_match_duration.question: Will the longest match at Wimbledon 2026 be 3+ hours long?
longest_match_duration.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the longest match in the tournament exceeds the listed number of hours. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will use the official match duration (understood as the time between first serve and the final point of the match) as reported by Wimbledon and/or the AELTC to resolve this market. 

Changeovers, time between points, medical timeouts, and more will all be counted toward the time of the official match. Full suspensions of play (i.e. weather delay, darkness stoppages, or any interruption that causes the umpire to formally suspend the match) will not be counted toward a match’s official duration.

If a match is started but not completed for any reason (e.g. abandoned without a result), this market will resolve according to the official matchtime prior to suspension.

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC and Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

code_violation.question: Wimbledon 2026: Will Nick Kyrgios Receive A Code Violation?
code_violation.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Will Nick Kyrgios Receive A Code Violation?
code_violation.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Nick Kyrgios receives a code violation in at least one official match during the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Code violations are determined by the chair umpire and may include, but are not limited to: racket or ball abuse, unsportsmanlike conduct, visible or audible obscenity, time violations, attire, etc.

If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled, or postponed after July 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

retirement_announcement.question: Will Novak Djokovic announce his retirement by September 30, 2026?
retirement_announcement.event_title: Will Novak Djokovic announce his retirement by...?
retirement_announcement.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Novak Djokovic officially announces his retirement from ATP Tour professional tennis by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

To resolve "Yes", the announcement must clearly state that Novak Djokovic is retiring or indefinitely departing from ATP Tour professional tennis with intention of not participating in any event that contributes to an ATP ranking. The announcement must come from Novak Djokovic or official representatives thereof.

Only announcements which are framed as announcing a departure from professional competition intended to be effective within 12 months of the date of the announcement will qualify (e.g., neither "I will leave competition in 2 years," nor "I will not play forever," would qualify).

If Djokovic retires in a qualifying manner but maintains, renews, or announces his intention to participate in the Olympics, that retirement will still qualify. Olympic participation, or participation in a tennis competition which does not contribute to an ATP ranking, will have no bearing on this market.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the named individual or authorized representatives thereof.

qualify_finals.question: Will Carlos Alcaraz Qualify for the Nitto ATP Finals 2026?
qualify_finals.event_title: Nitto ATP Finals: Player to Qualify
qualify_finals.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the specified player qualifies for the singles main draw of the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals, currently scheduled for November 15, 2026 to November 22, 2026, in Turin, Italy. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

A player is considered to have "qualified" if they are named to one of the eight (8) singles main-draw spots according to the official ATP source.

If a player qualifies but withdraws before competing, they will still be considered to have "qualified" and this market will resolve "Yes."

If the tournament is postponed beyond December 6, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, canceled, or the eight-player singles field has not been officially determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No."

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the ATP Tour (atptour.com); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

year_end_ranking.question: Will Jannik Sinner Make the Top 10 in the 2026 ATP end of year rankings
year_end_ranking.event_title: ATP 2026 End of Year Rankings: Player to Make Top 10
year_end_ranking.description:
This market will resolve "Yes" if the listed player finishes the 2026 season ranked within the top 10 (positions 1 through 10, inclusive) of the official year-end ATP singles rankings. Otherwise, this market will resolve "No".

The "year-end ATP singles rankings" are the final official singles rankings published after the conclusion of the 2026 ATP Tour season, including the ATP Finals. 

A player ranked exactly 10th counts as "Yes"; a player ranked 11th or lower, or unranked, counts as "No".

If the ATP does not publish a year-end singles ranking for 2026, or the season is not completed, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be the official ATP year-end singles rankings published at atptour.com; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

ranking_points.question: Will Jannik Sinner have 15,000+ ATP Points Before 2027?
ranking_points.event_title: Will Jannik Sinner have 15,000+ ATP Points Before 2027?
ranking_points.description:
This market will resolve "Yes" if Jannik Sinner's official ATP singles ranking points total reaches or exceeds 15,000 at any point on or before December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve "No".

"ATP ranking points" refers to Sinner's total points as shown in his official ATP singles ranking (the rolling 52-week total) in any official weekly ranking update published on or before December 31, 2026. If any single official ranking release during this period shows Sinner with 15,000 or more points, this market resolves "Yes."

The points total is measured strictly from the official ATP singles rankings, not the "Race to Turin" standings, live rankings, or any projected or unofficial total.

The primary resolution source will be the official ATP singles rankings published at atptour.com; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

celebrity_attendance.question: Will Tommy Hilfiger attend the US Open Finals?
celebrity_attendance.event_title: Who will attend the US Open Finals?
celebrity_attendance.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed individual attends the 2026 US Open men's singles final, scheduled for September 13, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Attending is defined as being in physical attendance at venue during any part of the men's singles final. Attendance at any other session, match, or event during the 2026 US Open will not qualify.

If the men's singles final is cancelled, or is postponed to a point after October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

suspension_duration.question: Nick Kyrgios suspended for less than 4 months
suspension_duration.event_title: How long will Nick Kyrgios' suspension be?
suspension_duration.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the total period of ineligibility imposed on Nick Kyrgios in the first sanction decision issued by the International Tennis Integrity Agency (ITIA), or by an independent tribunal under the Tennis Anti-Doping Programme, in the anti-doping case concerning Nick Kyrgios’s positive test for cocaine (sample collected June 22, 2026; provisional suspension effective August 4, 2026) is less than 4 months (including a case that concludes with no period of ineligibility). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If the period of ineligibility is expressed in days, one month will be considered equivalent to 30 days for the purposes of this market.

The full stated period of ineligibility will be used, regardless of any backdating of its start date or credit for time served under provisional suspension. This market will resolve based on the first sanction decision issued in the case; subsequent appeals will not be considered.

If no such decision is issued by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market group will resolve to "11+ months".

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ITIA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play.
If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.
The primary resolution source will be official information from the WTA Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

nationality_champion.question: Will an American player win the 2026 US Open?

nationality_champion.description:

A champion in either singles draw is sufficient for this market to resolve to "Yes"; both draws do not need to be won by an American player. Doubles, mixed doubles, wheelchair, and junior events do not count toward this market.

A player's nationality will be determined by the country listed for that player in the official 2026 U.S. Open draws and results. A player listed as representing the United States of America qualifies regardless of birthplace or other citizenships held.

If neither the 2026 U.S. Open Men's Singles Tournament nor the 2026 U.S. Open Women's Singles Tournament has a declared champion by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be official information from the U.S. Open (https://www.usopen.org/index.html); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

unbeaten_champion.question: Nitto ATP Finals 2026: Unbeaten Champion?
unbeaten_champion.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals singles champion goes unbeaten in every match during the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals, currently scheduled for November 15 to November 22, 2026, in Turin, Italy. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Unbeaten" means the champion did not record a loss in any singles match they played at the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals, across the round-robin stage, the semifinals, and the final (a 5-0 record for a player who plays all five matches). A loss by retirement or walkover counts as a loss. A champion who entered the tournament as an alternate is unbeaten only if they did not lose any match they played.

If the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals are canceled, postponed after December 6, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is no confirmed unbeaten champion within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the ATP Tour (https://www.atptour.com); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

tennis_match_totals.description:
This market refers to the tennis match between Ugo Blanchet and Vadym Ursu in the Brest Qualifying, originally scheduled for October 26, 2026 at 6:00AM ET.
This market will resolve to "Over" if the total number of games completed equals or exceeds 24. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Under." All tiebreaks, including any Champions/Super tiebreak, count as one (1) game.
If the match is postponed or suspended, this market will remain open until the match has been completed. A postponement alone will not trigger a 50-50 resolution.
If the match is permanently abandoned before completion, or if the match has not been completed by November 9, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome has already been unconditionally determined based on completed play. An outcome is considered unconditionally determined if it would have been guaranteed under every possible completion of the match played according to the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round, including whether a final set is played as a full set or as a match tiebreak. For example, for a line of 21.5, if play stops at 6-3, 5-6, completing the match would have required at least 2 additional games, resulting in at least 22 games played, so "Over" would resolve as the winning outcome. Likewise, if the published format replaces the final set with a match tiebreak, that tiebreak counts as one (1) game, so for a line of 22.5, if play stops at 6-2, 3-3, the match could have reached at most 22 games and "Under" would resolve as the winning outcome.
The primary resolution source for this market will be official ATP Tour statistics; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

qualifier_reach_round.question: Wimbledon 2026: Will a Qualifier Reach the Round of 16?
qualifier_reach_round.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Will a Qualifier Reach the Round of 16?
qualifier_reach_round.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a player listed as a qualifier or lucky loser reaches the Round of 16 in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only players who entered the main draw through the qualifying tournament or are nominated as a lucky loser will be considered. Players who received direct entry into the main men’s or women’s singles tournaments of Wimbledon will not be considered.

If no qualifiers or lucky losers are admitted to the main draw at Wimbledon, this market will resolve to 50-50.


If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled, or postponed after July 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

wildcard_reach_round.question: Wimbledon 2026: Wildcard to Reach the Quarterfinals?
wildcard_reach_round.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Wildcard to Reach the Quarterfinals?
wildcard_reach_round.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a player listed as a wildcard reaches the Quarterfinals in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only players who are listed as wildcards will be considered. Players who received direct entry or advance through the qualifying tournament into the main men’s or women’s single tournaments of Wimbledon will not be considered.

If no wildcards are admitted to the main tournament at Wimbledon, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled, or postponed after July 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

defeat_top_seed.question: Wimbledon 2026: Joao Fonseca to Defeat Top-5 Seed?
defeat_top_seed.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Joao Fonseca to Defeat Top-5 Seed?
defeat_top_seed.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Joao Fonseca defeats a player seeded number 5 or higher during any main tournament match in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If Joao Fonseca withdraws from the tournament, an applicable match is ruled a walkover this market will resolve to “No”. If an applicable match is started but not completed (e.g., abandoned without a result), this market will resolve to 50-50. A result by retirement counts as a completed match and will resolve "Yes" or "No" according to which player is credited the win under AELTC rules.

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC and Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

racket_break.question: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Break a Racket?
racket_break.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Break a Racket?
racket_break.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player participating in an official match at the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon visibly breaks a racket during or immediately following that match by July 12, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

"Breaks a racket" means a player's actions visibly damage, crack, snap, shatter, or otherwise render an item unusable or clearly broken. Mere striking, slamming, or knocking over equipment without visible breakage will not qualify.

Only actions taken by a player during live match play, or immediately after the conclusion of that player's official match while on the court or on the official broadcast, will count. Damage occurring before a match, outside the official match area, during practice, backstage, or away from the broadcast match environment will not qualify.

If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon is canceled, postponed indefinitely, or if no official match of the tournament is completed by June 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No."

The resolution source will be the official Wimbledon broadcast; however, photographic and video evidence from a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

top_seed_first_round_exit.question: Wimbledon 2026: Top-10 Seed to Lose in First Round? (Women’s Singles)
top_seed_first_round_exit.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Top-10 Seed to Lose in First Round? (Women’s Singles)
top_seed_first_round_exit.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if a player seeded number 10 or higher is defeated during the first round of the Women’s Singles main tournament in the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If an applicable match is started but not completed (e.g., abandoned without a result), or not played, this market will resolve to 50-50. A result by retirement or walkover counts as a completed match and will resolve "Yes" or "No" according to which player is credited the win under AELTC rules.

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC and Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

dress_code_violation.question: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Violate Dress Code?
dress_code_violation.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Any Player to Violate Dress Code?
dress_code_violation.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if any player receives a penalty for violating the dress code set out by Wimbledon during the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The official dress code for the tournament will be based upon the guidelines published by Wimbledon (​​https://www.wimbledon.com/en_GB/the_championships/clothing_and_equipment).

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or it cannot be determined if any player has been penalized for a dress code violation during this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

longest_match_duration.question: Will the longest match at Wimbledon 2026 be 7+ hours long?
longest_match_duration.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the longest match in the tournament exceeds the listed number of hours. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will use the official match duration (understood as the time between first serve and the final point of the match) as reported by Wimbledon and/or the AELTC to resolve this market. 

Changeovers, time between points, medical timeouts, and more will all be counted toward the time of the official match. Full suspensions of play (i.e. weather delay, darkness stoppages, or any interruption that causes the umpire to formally suspend the match) will not be counted toward a match’s official duration.

If a match is started but not completed for any reason (e.g. abandoned without a result), this market will resolve according to the official matchtime prior to suspension.

If the Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled or postponed after July 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC and Wimbledon; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

code_violation.question: Wimbledon 2026: Will Nick Kyrgios Receive A Code Violation?
code_violation.event_title: Wimbledon 2026: Will Nick Kyrgios Receive A Code Violation?
code_violation.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Nick Kyrgios receives a code violation in at least one official match during the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Code violations are determined by the chair umpire and may include, but are not limited to: racket or ball abuse, unsportsmanlike conduct, visible or audible obscenity, time violations, attire, etc.

If the 2026 Championships at Wimbledon are cancelled, or postponed after July 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the AELTC; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

retirement_announcement.question: Will Novak Djokovic announce his retirement by November 30, 2026?
retirement_announcement.event_title: Will Novak Djokovic announce his retirement by...?
retirement_announcement.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Novak Djokovic officially announces his retirement from ATP Tour professional tennis by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

To resolve "Yes", the announcement must clearly state that Novak Djokovic is retiring or indefinitely departing from ATP Tour professional tennis with intention of not participating in any event that contributes to an ATP ranking. The announcement must come from Novak Djokovic or official representatives thereof.

Only announcements which are framed as announcing a departure from professional competition intended to be effective within 12 months of the date of the announcement will qualify (e.g., neither "I will leave competition in 2 years," nor "I will not play forever," would qualify).

If Djokovic retires in a qualifying manner but maintains, renews, or announces his intention to participate in the Olympics, that retirement will still qualify. Olympic participation, or participation in a tennis competition which does not contribute to an ATP ranking, will have no bearing on this market.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the named individual or authorized representatives thereof.

qualify_finals.question: Will Elise Mertens Qualify for the WTA Finals 2026?
qualify_finals.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed player qualifies for the singles draw of the 2026 WTA Finals, currently scheduled for November 8 to November 15, 2026, in Indian Wells, United States, per WTA rules. Otherwise, the associated market will resolve to "No".

A player qualifies if the WTA officially names her as one of the eight singles qualifiers for the 2026 WTA Finals, whether through her position in the Race to the WTA Finals or through the WTA's Grand Slam champion qualification rule. The singles field has eight places, and a Grand Slam champion who qualifies under that rule fills one of those eight places. A player who qualifies and later withdraws before or during the tournament will still count as having qualified. A player who only takes part as an alternate, without being officially named as one of the eight singles qualifiers, will not count.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed player to qualify for the 2026 WTA Finals singles draw, the associated market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026 WTA Finals are canceled, postponed after November 29, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or the eight singles qualifiers have not been officially confirmed by the WTA within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the WTA (https://www.wtatennis.com); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

year_end_ranking.question: Will someone else be Number 1 on the End of Year WTA Rankings
year_end_ranking.event_title: WTA 2026 End of Year Rankings: Player to be Number 1
year_end_ranking.description:
This market will resolve according to the player who finishes World No. 1 in the official 2026 WTA year-end singles rankings, as published by the WTA at the conclusion of the 2026 season.

If the 2026 year-end rankings are not published, are canceled, or a year-end No. 1 has not been determined by January 14, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

If multiple players are tied and officially recognized as co-No. 1, this market will resolve in favor of the player whose listed name comes first alphabetically.

The resolution source for this market will be the official WTA year-end singles rankings as published by the WTA (https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/singles); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

ranking_points.question: Will Jannik Sinner have 15,000+ ATP Points Before 2027?
ranking_points.event_title: Will Jannik Sinner have 15,000+ ATP Points Before 2027?
ranking_points.description:
This market will resolve "Yes" if Jannik Sinner's official ATP singles ranking points total reaches or exceeds 15,000 at any point on or before December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve "No".

"ATP ranking points" refers to Sinner's total points as shown in his official ATP singles ranking (the rolling 52-week total) in any official weekly ranking update published on or before December 31, 2026. If any single official ranking release during this period shows Sinner with 15,000 or more points, this market resolves "Yes."

The points total is measured strictly from the official ATP singles rankings, not the "Race to Turin" standings, live rankings, or any projected or unofficial total.

The primary resolution source will be the official ATP singles rankings published at atptour.com; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

celebrity_attendance.question: Will Timothee Chalamet attend the US Open Finals?
celebrity_attendance.event_title: Who will attend the US Open Finals?
celebrity_attendance.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed individual attends the 2026 US Open men's singles final, scheduled for September 13, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Attending is defined as being in physical attendance at venue during any part of the men's singles final. Attendance at any other session, match, or event during the 2026 US Open will not qualify.

If the men's singles final is cancelled, or is postponed to a point after October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

suspension_duration.question: Nick Kyrgios suspended for 11 or more months
suspension_duration.event_title: How long will Nick Kyrgios' suspension be?
suspension_duration.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the total period of ineligibility imposed on Nick Kyrgios in the first sanction decision issued by the International Tennis Integrity Agency (ITIA), or by an independent tribunal under the Tennis Anti-Doping Programme, in the anti-doping case concerning Nick Kyrgios’s positive test for cocaine (sample collected June 22, 2026; provisional suspension effective August 4, 2026) is 11 months or longer. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If the period of ineligibility is expressed in days, one month will be considered equivalent to 30 days for the purposes of this market.

The full stated period of ineligibility will be used, regardless of any backdating of its start date or credit for time served under provisional suspension. This market will resolve based on the first sanction decision issued in the case; subsequent appeals will not be considered.

If no such decision is issued by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market group will resolve to "11+ months".

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ITIA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

tennis_game_handicap.question: Game Spread: Tereza Valentova (-4.5) vs Mia Pohankova (+4.5)
tennis_game_handicap.groupItemTitle: Pan Pacific Open: Tereza Valentova vs Mia Pohankova Game Spread +/-4.5
tennis_game_handicap.event_title: Pan Pacific Open: Tereza Valentova vs Mia Pohankova
tennis_game_handicap.description:
This market will resolve to "Tereza Valentova" if Tereza Valentova wins 4.5 or more total games than Mia Pohankova in the upcoming tennis match, scheduled for October 26, 2026 at 10:00PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Mia Pohankova".
Games won will be counted across all sets played in the match. A set decided by a tiebreak will count as one game for the winner of that tiebreak, and a match tiebreak played in place of a final set will also count as one game for its winner.
If the match is canceled (not played at all), or is delayed beyond 14 days from the scheduled date without completion at 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the match ends at a point where Tereza Valentova could no longer have finished 4.5 or more games ahead even by winning every remaining game, this market will resolve to "Mia Pohankova".
If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.
The primary resolution source will be official information from the WTA Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

promotion_count.question: Will Chipotle give out 32,500 or more BOGOs during the 2026 US Open?
promotion_count.event_title: How many Chipotle BOGOs will be given out during the 2026 US Open?
promotion_count.description:
This market will resolve according to the total number of buy-one-get-one (BOGO) entrée offer codes released by Chipotle through its "Every Win Tastes Better" promotion tied to Taylor Fritz's men's singles run at the 2026 US Open, from August 25, 2026 through September 15, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

If the event is not completed by September 29, 2026 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official announcements from Chipotle (https://newsroom.chipotle.com) and Taylor Fritz's official Instagram account (@taylor_fritz); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

nationality_champion.question: Will an American player win the 2026 US Open?
nationality_champion.event_title: Will an American player win the 2026 US Open?
nationality_champion.description:
The 2026 U.S. Open tennis tournament is scheduled for August 23 - September 13, 2026.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if a player representing the United States of America wins the 2026 U.S. Open Men's Singles Tournament or the 2026 U.S. Open Women's Singles Tournament. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A champion in either singles draw is sufficient for this market to resolve to "Yes"; both draws do not need to be won by an American player. Doubles, mixed doubles, wheelchair, and junior events do not count toward this market.

A player's nationality will be determined by the country listed for that player in the official 2026 U.S. Open draws and results. A player listed as representing the United States of America qualifies regardless of birthplace or other citizenships held.

If neither the 2026 U.S. Open Men's Singles Tournament nor the 2026 U.S. Open Women's Singles Tournament has a declared champion by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be official information from the U.S. Open (https://www.usopen.org/index.html); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

unbeaten_champion.question: Nitto ATP Finals 2026: Unbeaten Champion?
unbeaten_champion.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals singles champion goes unbeaten in every match during the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals, currently scheduled for November 15 to November 22, 2026, in Turin, Italy. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Unbeaten" means the champion did not record a loss in any singles match they played at the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals, across the round-robin stage, the semifinals, and the final (a 5-0 record for a player who plays all five matches). A loss by retirement or walkover counts as a loss. A champion who entered the tournament as an alternate is unbeaten only if they did not lose any match they played.

If the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals are canceled, postponed after December 6, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is no confirmed unbeaten champion within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the ATP Tour (https://www.atptour.com); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
